argv:
sh -c 'sh -c '"'"'
for path do
  if [ -f "$path" ]; then
    hash=$(sha256sum "$path" 2>/dev/null) || hash=
    [ -n "$hash" ] || hash=ERROR
    hash=${hash%% *}
    pkg=$(rpm -qf "$path" 2>/dev/null) || pkg=
    [ -n "$pkg" ] || pkg=NOT_OWNED
    etype=$(od -An -tu2 -j 16 -N 2 "$path" 2>/dev/null) || etype=
    [ -n "$etype" ] || etype=ERROR
    size=$(stat -c %s "$path" 2>/dev/null) || size=
    [ -n "$size" ] || size=ERROR
    printf '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' "$path" "$hash" "$pkg" "$etype" "$size"
  else
    printf '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'%s\tMISSING\tMISSING\tMISSING\tMISSING\n'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' "$path"
  fi
done
'"'"' sh /prd/usr/lib/libvconf-prd.so.1.0 /prd/usr/lib/libvconf_lite.so.0.3.1 /prd/usr/lib/libvideo-dp-control-impl-sec.so.0.1.0 /prd/usr/lib/libvideo-mm-control-impl-sec.so.0.1.0 /usr/lib/driver/libmali.so'; result=$?; printf '\n__PREP_REMOTE_RC=%s\n' "$result"
